name: Wilting Regrets
source:
If only we had one more chance.

When people are wronged, they cannot let go. They seek retribution, salvation, revenge. Even in death, those feelings persist, morphing the spirits of the dead into mangled beasts of the afterlife.

In this world where a place for the dead exist, it is the job of executioners to help those spirits find peace by removing their regrets. However, at times the spirits long for the death of the ones who wronged them, and through careful examination, it is allowed for an executioner to end those lives in place of the wronged.

Executioner. A job for criminals, those who have no place in the living world that they have no choice but to live between hell and the living.

You, Spider Lily, are one of the executioners specializing in revenge.

And one day, just before the week of Halloween, two new cases find their way to you.

[From [url=https://kitome-games.itch.io/wilting-regrets]Itch.io[/url]]
